# Iteration 11 test set

From the first live reel (job 7e9fcc49), for builders without `.explainers-local`.

- `video-phone.mp4`: the phone copy of the delivered reel, 720 wide. Use it to test moments and sheets.
- `contact-sheet.png`: the delivered contact sheet.
- `project/`: the reel's project without its renders, voice audio, music, sound effects, `.claude`, kit or fonts. Copy `explainers/reel-ai-drama/kit` to `assets/kit` to run it.
- `project/assets/media/`: only the pictures for frames 4, 8 and 9. Other frames' pictures are missing, so test on those three.
- `V45.keyed.png` is the ICE seal that rendered as a black dot on frame 8.
